probe_objective: Determine whether a per-session event stream capability exists in the Claude Code Remote MCP API (per §7 design doc, which references 'a list_events capability')
probe_method: ToolSearch with keyword queries including 'event', 'stream', 'list_events', with scope limited to deferred Claude_Code_Remote tools

implication_for_phase_1.note: Design doc §7 (line 218-219) anticipated needing to spike whether list_events exists for cloud sessions. Probe result: no list_events or similar event-stream tool is currently exposed in the deferred tools list. This likely means: (a) the capability may exist but is not yet wired into the MCP surface, or (b) it was planned but not yet implemented, or (c) events are accessed via a different mechanism (not yet discovered). Further investigation required at Phase 2 or later, but V1 does not depend on it — coarse telemetry via list_sessions is sufficient.
implication_for_phase_1.fallback: §7 already planned for coarse fidelity on cloud sessions if granular events are unavailable. Tool-stroke animation will render as inferred (ghosted per §5) for cloud sessions. Local sessions get fine-grained events from ~/.claude JSONL (Phase 2+).
